name: Tomato and egg rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice in water until tender.
Dice the onion and tomato. Soften the onion in the oil, then cook the tomato until it starts to break down.
Stir in the rice and eggs. Keep stirring over medium heat until the eggs are fully set.

name: Chickpea and tomato pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in water and drain it.
Chop the tomato and cook it in the oil until soft. Stir in the drained chickpeas and warm through.
Toss the pasta with the chickpea mixture.

name: Carrot and lentil rice
steps: Cook the rice and red lentils in water according to their package instructions.
Dice the onion and grate the carrot. Cook them together in the oil until soft.
Fold the cooked rice and lentils into the vegetables and warm through.

name: Spinach omelette with potatoes
steps: Dice the potatoes, boil them in water until tender, and drain.
Warm the oil in a pan and stir in the spinach until wilted. Add the potatoes.
Beat the eggs, pour them over the pan, and cook until fully set.

name: Potato, tomato, and egg hash
steps: Dice the potatoes. Boil them in water until just tender and drain.
Soften the chopped onion in the oil. Stir in the potato and chopped tomato and cook until the tomato softens.
Crack the egg into the pan and cook it through.

name: Chickpea and tomato rice
steps: Cook the rice in water until tender.
Soften the diced onion in the oil and add the chopped tomato. Stir in the drained chickpeas and warm through.
Serve the tomato and chickpea mixture over the rice.

name: Spinach and tomato sauce pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in water and drain it.
Wilt the spinach in the oil, then add the tomato sauce and heat through.
Mix in the pasta and serve.

name: Carrot and red lentil soup
steps: Dice the carrots, onion, and potato.
Soften the onion in the oil in a saucepan. Add the carrots, potato, lentils, and enough water to cover them.
Simmer until the lentils and vegetables are tender.
